mapper.select: SELECT ips.security_code ,ips.security_short_name ,si.issuer_code ,si.issuer issuer_name ,ips.target_pool_id current_pool_id ,ips.target_pool_name current_pool_name ,p.inner_sort current_sort FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN ip_investment_pool p ON p.id = ips.target_pool_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.wind_code = ips.security_code WHERE ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND p.pool_type = 'credit_bond' AND p.inner_sort BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND (p.pool_level IS NULL OR p.pool_level = 2)

SELECT id ,security_code ,security_short_name ,issuer_code ,issuer_name ,current_pool_id ,current_pool_name ,current_sort ,fail_reason ,special_type_desc ,alert_status ,last_scan_time ,deal_user_id ,deal_user_name ,deal_time ,crte_time ,updt_time FROM ip_grade_rule_alert
AND is_deleted = 0
AND security_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityCode}, '%')
AND alert_status = #{alertStatus}
ORDER BY last_scan_time DESC ,id DESC

SELECT id ,security_code ,current_pool_id ,alert_status FROM ip_grade_rule_alert WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND alert_status = '00' AND security_code = #{securityCode} AND current_pool_id = #{currentPoolId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id ,security_code ,security_short_name ,issuer_code ,issuer_name ,current_pool_id ,current_pool_name ,current_sort ,fail_reason ,special_type_desc ,alert_status ,last_scan_time ,deal_user_id ,deal_user_name ,deal_time FROM ip_grade_rule_alert WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ip_grade_rule_alert WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND alert_status = '00'
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_grade_rule_alert SET alert_status = '99' ,updt_time = #{scanTime} WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND alert_status = '00' AND (last_scan_time IS NULL OR last_scan_time < #{scanTime})
